title: Every change, checked
sub: AI and continuous architecture: every element on the map carries its owner and its source, so the map is tested on every change, each rule with a case that must fail; the map agent's walk of a change is tested on one whose answer is known, then walks a new one down to the tables, checked against what is really running, and the owners decide.
howto: Clay and daylight are Babylon, over 2,600 years ago: its river wall of baked brick, and the king's name and the brick's work stamped on its edge. In the present, a teal orb is the map agent. The map is glass in its layers' colours, each element with its owner's gold tag and its source. A check that passes ticks green; one that fails is marked red. Blue is the network and rose is retail, with the wall between them; gold marks owners and the business side, cyan the technical side.
